name: modal-dialog
description: Create a reusable modal dialog component

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript Modal class that can show/hide and handle callbacks. Include proper interfaces for options.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript Modal class that can show/hide and handle callbacks.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript Modal class with JSDoc annotations that can show/hide and handle callbacks.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a reusable modal dialog component in vanilla JavaScript. Include:

**HTML Structure:**
- Modal overlay (semi-transparent background)
- Modal container (centered box)
- Header with title and close button (X)
- Content area
- Footer with action buttons

**CSS:**
- Overlay covers full screen
- Modal is centered (vertically and horizontally)
- Smooth fade-in/fade-out animation
- Close button styled
- Backdrop click closes modal
- Responsive design

**JavaScript:**
- Modal class or factory function
- Methods: open(), close(), setContent()
- Click outside to close
- ESC key to close
- Event listeners for buttons
- Clean up on close

**Example Usage:**
```javascript
const modal = new Modal({
  title: 'Confirm Action',
  content: 'Are you sure?',
  onConfirm: () => console.log('confirmed')
});
modal.open();
```

Return as a single HTML file demonstrating the modal.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Create a reusable modal dialog with complete JSDoc documentation. Same requirements as javascript-vanilla-web, plus:

- @typedef for ModalOptions
- @typedef for ModalConfig
- Complete @param and @return documentation
- @class documentation for the Modal class
- Document all public methods

Return as a single HTML file.
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a reusable modal dialog using TypeScript and vanilla Web APIs. Include:

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for ModalOptions (title, content, buttons, callbacks)
- Modal class with proper typing
- Type-safe event handlers
- Generic content type support

**Features:**
- Open/close methods
- Keyboard support (ESC to close)
- Click outside to close
- Customizable buttons
- Callbacks for actions
- Animation support

**HTML/CSS:**
- Clean, modern design
- Proper overlay and centering
- Animations

Provide TypeScript source and HTML structure.
